title: show: print the stored file; new trust command for the tier
summary: Specified on top of CR-101 and trust-actor-forms: show writes the stored bytes (any encoding, no trust line); new okf-schema trust prints trust/stale lines, refuses non-UTF-8 (exit 2); ConceptDetail gains raw; CORE-005 S5, CORE-006 S6-S8 and wider statement, CORE-010 widened; feat, 0.19.0.
